stairs.label: Emergency unknown scroll read on a doorway
stairs.explanation: A wounded level-1 Warrior on an open doorway reads an unknown scroll to survive a summoner. The scroll is a Rune of Protection and the doorway cannot hold one, so the game reports no clear floor. The tracker count goes below zero; the next glyph creation then writes before the start of the arrays.

clear-floor.label: Control: the same read on open floor
